description: A signed price for one offer (from list_offers) on one listing, valid for a short time, and whether the listing can have it now. Only the account that owns the listing gets one: send its session Cookie header, or its agent key as Authorization: Bearer, on the MCP request. Refusals say why and what to do (httpStatus 401 sign_in_required, 403 not_owner with the claim page, 409 not_accepted, already_live, already_bought, category_full). Nothing is reserved or charged.

listing.description: The listing id or slug (from search_listings or get_listing).

offer.description: An offer id from list_offers, e.g. boost.
